tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi man ngag zab mo rnams bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsakra saṃ bha ra ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du/ byad ma 'bum rdugs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la lo rgyus dang*/ las tshogs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ba ri lo tsā ba rgya gar du byon pa la/ bal po na/ mu stegs kyi ston pa skal ldan rgyal po dang rtsod pa byas pa las/ skal ldan rgyal po pham pas kho khros nas/ khyod ngas zhag bdun gyi tshe las med par bya'o zer/ de ma yin na khyod nga'i bstan pa la zhugs dgos zer ba la/ nga khyod kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa las/ da lta rang shi na dga' gsungs pas/ der khong gnyis ma 'cham par byas nas ba ri ba bal po spyi ther pa'i drung du byon/ mu stegs kyi ston pa skal ldan rgyal po dang rtsod pa byas pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ zhag bdun kyi tshe las med par byed do zer ba zhus pas/ bal po spyi ther ba la phar bu gcig 'dug pa nas rkang mgyogs kyi rdzas bton/ rkang pa la byugs nas bal yul gyi nyi ma dros pa la phyin pas/ rdo rje gdan du nyi ma phyed pa la slebs pas/ rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du zhus pa dang*/ de ring tshes dgu yin/ nangs par tshes bcu la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po shoms dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan cig 'ong gis gsungs pa la/ gser zho bzhi'i rin gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams nas/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la gser srang bzhi phul bas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis nam mkha' nas/ bu ba ri ba rdo rje gdan kyi byang phyogs su brag g.yag 'dra ba'i 'og na/ khru gsum gyi gting na sol ba'i dong zhig yod/ de'i 'og na la cha'i sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na bse'i sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na byang chub shing gi sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na dngul gyi sgrom bu zhig yod/

de'i nang na gser gyi sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na g.yu'i sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na bai ḍūrya'i sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang na rin po che padma rā ga'i sgrom bu zhig yod/ de'i nang du chu dar smugs po la nged mkha' 'gro ma'i snying gi khrag rlangs kyis bris pa'i yi ge bcu bzhi yod/ mgo na oṃ med/ mjug na swā hā med/ gi gur btags med/ na ro zhabs kyu dang 'greng bu med/ bar na tshag med/ de nyin re la nyi shu rtsa gcig re thon/ de bas mang ba bton na mi yong gsungs/ de nas khong gis sang nyin dmar gtor chen po gcig bcas khyer byin nas/ brag g.yag ro can du phyin nas brkos pas/ de nas sol ba'i dong nas sgrom bu byung*/ de'i sngags nyin mtshan med par bzlas pas/ mun rub pa la mu stegs kyis mkha' 'gro ma sbran byung ba phyir bzlog thub/ srod la 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre thams cad sbran byung ba bzlog thub/ nam phyed la ye shes pa thams cad sbran byung ba bzlog thub/ tho rengs mkha' 'gro ma thams cad sbran byung ba bzlog thub bo// de nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi zhal nas/ mu stegs kyi ston pa skal ldan rgyal po kha nas khrag skyugs te shi gsungs pas ba ri bas ngom ngom byas nas/ rdo rje gdan pa la zhus pas/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung gis/ dus snyigs ma'i sems can/ slob dpon nga 'dra ba yod pa/ slob ma khyod 'dra ba yong ba gsungs nas/ ba ri ba'i ske nas sgrom bu yod pa rdo rje gdan pas bcad nas phrog de nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bla ma dang mjal kha ma btang bas/ der dge tshul ma hā sha sa ma bya bas/ 'bras spar ba gsum re tsam/ chang phor chung re tsam ske rags dkyil du gtums kyin byin/ de nas ba ri ba mtha' ma mjal kha rnyed/ de nas bod du byon/ sa chen kun snying la gnang*/ de nas rim pa bzhin du brgyud do// ༈ /gnyis pa 'di'i las tshogs la/

zlog pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ srung ba dang*/ tshe sgrub pa dang*/ nor sgrub pa dang*/ dbang du sdud pa dang*/ sre'u gso ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa dang*/ char gcod pa dang*/ zhing gi 'bu srung ba dang*/ sad srung ba dang*/ ser ba srung ba dang*/ thog srung ba dang*/ lug nad srung ba/ g.yag nad gcod pa dang*/ lhog pa srung ba/ rims nad srung ba/ 'brum bu srung ba/ 'khru ba gcod pa/ 'go yor srung ba/ mtshon srung ba/ gza' nad srung ba gnyis/ jag chings dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// ༈ /'di'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ba la/ rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can zhal shin tu gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing*/ nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'phro ba/ smin ma glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khro gnyer dpral pa'i dbyings su bsdus pa/ dbu skra g.yu'i ral pa can gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su slebs pa/ de'i gseb na me'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ phyag g.yas pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku las bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rakta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing phyi rting bha ga la gtad pa/ g.yon dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ sku las bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba'i nang na ḍā ki ma de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ g.yas thams cad na lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu/ mda'/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'khor lo/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon thams cad thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba sgom/ zlog pa'i dus su g.yas nyi ma/ g.yon zla bar bsgom/ gsod pa'i dus/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus/ lte ba man chad lcags phur zur gsum du bsgom/ rū pa'i snying dkar nag mtshams su btsugs nas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'jibs nas/ kho'i lus sgog pa'i shun pa bzhin du btang bar bsam/ ngag gnon byed na lce la btsugs par bsam// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ de la gong bsnyen khri tsho gsum bya/ des las 'grub par 'gyur ro// de'i lag len ni// ༈ /zlog

2 pa la/ nyi ma gshegs la phyed kyi dus su bsgom/ nyi zla gnyis kyi bar du byad ma dmar char char song bar bsams nas thal mo brdab par bya'o// sngags sum brgya'o// ༈ /gsod pa 3 la/ rang drag mo gri gug thogs pa/ gri gug gis snying la sogs pa dum bur gshog par dmigs nas/ rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam// ༈ /sra 4 ུnga ba la/ rang nyid ye shes kyi ḍā ki mar bskyed/ phyag g.yas na gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ rang gi bsrung bya thams cad 'khor lo'i nang du tshud nas srung bar bsam/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs stong gi nang na/ ḍā ki ma stong yod par bsam/ rtsibs mchan la khro mo stong zhal phyir bstan nas bzhugs par bsam/ bsrung bya thams cad khro chu'i pha wang ltar bsgom/ mi la 'dogs na gser gyis bris nas mgo mjug ma log par byed gri lcags kyi sbubs la bcug kha la chas bcad/ zhing lpags kyis gtums/ pho'i dpung pa g.yon la 'dogs/ mo'i dpung pa g.yas la 'dogs/ de ni srung ba'i man ngag go /// ༈ /tshe sgru 5 ba ni/ rang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog dkar mo tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ tho rangs kha nub phyogs su bstan la/ sngags stong bzla'o// des bar chad thams cad zhi bar bsam mo// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥde nyin re bzhin stong bzlas na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gyur ro// ༈ /nor sgru 6 ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro nag mo phyag g.yas pa na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon padma'i phor ba rin po ches gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bzhugs pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ sngags 'bum tsho gcig bzla'o// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥsiddhi āḥhūm̐/ des 'grub par the tshom med// ༈ /dbang 7 sdud byed na/ rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog dmar mo g.yas na lcags kyu 'dzin pa/

g.yon na gter gyi bum pa dkur brten pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs su ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ sngags 'bum tsho gsum bzla'o// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥphaṭaḥ'agro ba thams cad dbang du sdus shig swā hā/ 'di zhu ba la gser srang re'i bka' rgya'o// ༈ /sri'u gso ba ni/ rdzas gsum la brten nas gso ba la/ mi grir shi ba'i rus pa/ gu gul/ rta bon rnams ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten du bskyed/ sngags stong tsho gsum bdun gyis rdzas la btab/ zhib tu btags nas/ par bu'i nang du tshag byed/ pho mo gang yin yang 'dra/ phru gu skye ma thag la/ lte thag ma bcad pa la spyi bo/ skra mtshams/ mig rna ba/ sna/ kha/ mchan khung*/ nu ma/ srin mdzub/ snying ga lte ba/ rkang pa'i mtheb srin rnams su thig le gnyis gnyis bya/ hūm̐ nag po re res bsrungs par bsam/ hūm̐ rnams mkha' 'gro mar bsgom/ byis pa pho mo gang yin yang ngu ba'i lugs med/ 'dre'i gnod pa mi yong*/ de zhu ba la gser zho re'i bka' rgya yod// ༈ /char pa 'beb 9 sa pa ni/ rang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du bsgom/ klu brgyad dbang du bsdu ba la skyer pa'i phur pa sor bzhi pa byas/ sngags stong tsho gsum btab/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ ga bur gsum gyis byugs la/ chu mig kha shar bstan du sbas/ phyogs bzhir klu gtor btang*/ tho bzhi btsugs/ rab zhag gsum/ 'bring bzhi/ tha ma lnga la mi 'bab mi srid do// lag len la brtson 'grus bskyed/ bka' rgya la gser zho do yod/ man ngag zhal las shes so// ༈ /char pa gcod 10 pa ni/ rang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du bskyed/ nam mkha' lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs 'bum dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom/ sa rnams lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom/ de gnyis bar du dus mtha'i me 'bar bar bsgom/

de'i nang du rang skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal shin tu gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ shangs nas khams gsum 'thor ba'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la bsgrad pa/ smin ma glog ltar 'khyugs pa/ khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su slebs pa/ klu brgyad dbang du sdud pa'i sbrul nag po'i thod bcings pa/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ ser po'i mgul rgyan/ dkar po'i dpung rgyan dang zhabs gdub byas pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes kyi me phung nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar me phung 'dzin pa dku la brten pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gar stabs su bzhugs pa/ de lta bur bskyed/ char pa gtong ba'i lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bya spu me la sbar ba bzhin du gzhob thul thul song bar bsam/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ga ru ḍa sha da ra sa mā ra ya phaṭa/ sngags gsum brgya bzlas la/ sdigs mdzub byas la 'bud/ logs thams cad me ri me phung gis khengs par bsam/ char gcod pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// ༈ /zhing gi 'ab 11 ུ srung ba ni/ tho rangs bye ma blangs nas sngags stong btab nas gtor bas 'bu yul nas bud 'gro/ bya dang byi'u ri bong sogs thams cad thub bo// ༈ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis sad srung ba'i man nga 12 ga ni/ chu zangs gzhong gang steng du 'jog de'i chu nang du klu sa bdag lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'gugs gzhug drag po byas nas/ de'i chu nang na mngon sum du yod par bsam/ de'i nang nas kha rlangs kyi sprin 'thibs par bsam/ sngags sum brgya chu la 'debs so// des sprin 'du bar bsgom/ the tshom med par srung ba'i man ngag go/ ༈ /ser ba srung ba

13 ni/ rang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du bsgom/ nam mkha' me phung 'bar bar bsgom// sngags stong tsho gcig nam mkha' la 'debs/ tho rangs byas pas ser ba thub par the tshom med do// ༈ /thog sra 1 ུnga 4 ba ni/ rang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar bsgom/ spyi bor gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor bar bsam/ rang lus srung ba ni sngags gser gyis bris la btags/ de ni thog srung ba'o// ༈ /lug 15 nad gcod pa ni/ dkar gong srin med phye ma bre do la/ dug gi khu bas bran/ sngags stong tsho gcig btab/ dgong ka lug gi mdun na bab/ lug nad thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa bzhin song bar bsams te/ lug nad thams cad thub par the tshom med do// ༈ /g.yag nad 16 gcod pa la/ bal dkar po/ nag po/ dmar po gsum la skud pa sum bsgril byas la mdud pa gsum btab la/ sngags stong tsho gsum btab nas btags na g.yag nad kyi rigs thams cad gcod thub par the tshom med do// ༈ /lhog pa 17 srung ba la/ sngags stong tsho re bzlas nas chu la btab nas blud pas thub par the tshom med do// ༈ /rims 18 srung ba ni/ shu dag dang*/ bong nga nag po gnyis la sngags brgya btab nas bdug pa'am btags pas thub bo// ༈ /'brum nad sru 19 nga ba la/ sran ma bdun la sngags brgya btab nas zos pa'am lus la btags na thub bo// ༈ /'khru 20 ba gcod pa la/ khyi rgya bo'i bal la bu gtsang mas bsnyod/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i skud pa sum bsgril la sngags stong tsho gsum btab/ lus dang rkang pa la btags na them bu bcad pa bzhin 'gro bar the tshom med do// ༈ / 21 'go yor srung ba ni/ gser gyi me btsa' dpral bar rgyab na thub/ man ngag zhal las shes so// ༈ /mtshon srung 22 ba la/ gser dang*/ padma rakta bsres la srung ba bris nas lus la btags na the tshom med do// man ngag zhal las shes so// ༈ /gza' 23 nad srung ba ni/ gu gul la sngags stong btab nas thang btang na/

gza' nad gar song cha med la 'gro/ ༈ /yang gza' 24 nad 'chos pa lugs gcig la/ mthong ba'i dug reg pa'i dug kha rlangs kyi dug tshor ba'i dug bsam pa'i dug dang lnga'o// spyang ki'i brun/ gu gul nag po/ btsan dug yug sa mo'i rmongs spu/ rta nag gi bon/ de rnams zhib par btags nas bdugs na gar song cha med la 'gro'o// man ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes so// ༈ /ja 25 ga chings ni/ rang nyid ḍā ki mar bsgoms sngags lnga brgya bzlas te rkang 'og gis blangs nas btab la gar 'gro'i sar sngon du rlung la bskur bas me phung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog par bsam/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi lam srung zab bo// // ༈ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi man ngag mkha' 'gro stong gi nang nas phyir zlog pa'i thabs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ mkha' 'gro ma stong gi srog snying nang nas/ zlog pa'i thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku tshad ri rab tsam yod pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de'i nga rgyal brtan pa'i sgo nas sngags 'di 'dren no// zhes sogs spyi dang mthun no// 'dren pa'i dus su ngag bcad phreng ba phyir bsgyur te/ nyi ma nub 'gro ba'i gong la tshugs tsam byas nas gang 'grub byas na/ mthu gtad mnan gsum gyis mi tshugs so// aḥs ye shes pa dang tshangs pa'i gnod pa sel/ kaḥyis lha ma yin gyi gnod pa sel/ saḥyis sa bdag gi gnod pa sel/ maḥyis ma mo'i gnod pa sel/ raḥyis rgyal po'i gnod pa sel/ tsaḥyis btsan gyi gnod pa sel/ shaḥyis gshin rje'i gon pa sel/ daḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥkyis sde brgyad yongs kyi gnod pa sel lo// 'di'i mngon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/

dang po nyi ma ri rtse la 'gro ba'i dus su kha phyir bltas la gos mgo mjug bzlog la gon/ phreng ba phyir bgrang zhing ting nge 'dzin bsgom mo// de'ang swa bhā was stong par sbyangs nas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de'i ngang las yig 'bru rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dgra bgegs thams cad sreg par byed pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las dgra bgegs pho mo bsgyel ba'i snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsam/ de las 'od zer dmar nag 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi dgra bgegs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du dmigs bya 'khor dang bcas pa bsgral/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ lcags kyi ral pa sngon po thur du 'phyang ba/ zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ mig me mdag gi phung po ltar dmar la zlum pa gsum bsgrad pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de'i gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwām̐ ga rtse gsum dkur brten pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas pa'i mthe bong gtad pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs u rgyan yul nas rang dang 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sde spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag byas/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ chos 'byung gi rtse la nyi ma sngon la 'gro ba'i dus/ dmigs pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro bar bsams la bzla bar bya'o// sngags kyi gzhug tu/ phaṭa sha tsa ra ma sa ka zhes pa 'di shes par bya'o// nges par bzlog na/ ka sa ma ra tsa sha phaṭa/ 'di'i bzlas pa la/ nyi ma ri la 'gro ba'i dus dang mnyam mo// thal mo brdab cing dmod mo bya'o// mthar dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/

badzra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku'i tshad ni ri rab tsam yod pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ de'i nga rgyal brtan po'i sgo nas sngags bzlas/ smra bcad byas shing phreng ba phyir la bsgyur la phul te/ nyi ma nub 'gro ba'i sngon la tshud tsam byas la/ ci 'grub byas na mthu gtad mnan gsum gyis mi tshugs/ rbod kha gnod 'dre ga la yong*// lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa zlog /rme yug 'khon gsum yong mi srid// sa bdag klu gnyan gnod pa zlog /dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma zlog /'gal rkyen bar chad 'di yis sel// tshe yi dngos grub 'di yis ster// bsod nams chen po shin tu 'phel// nad gdon bar chad thams cad 'di yis srung*// bsam pa'i don kun 'di yis 'grub bo// ༈ /yang mkha' 'gro ma shin tu drag mo byed na/ skad cig gis/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddha sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhi gnam lcags las grub pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi rol nas bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ las mkhan dang*/ dgra bgegs pho mo dang bcas pa bsgyel ba'i snying gar rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dmar nag mtshon cha lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mkha' 'gro ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/

sku mdog nag mo ral pa phyed spyi bor thor cog bcings pa lhag mas sku lus khyab pa'o// ral pa nyag re re la dug shing gri lcags dang mi rkang las byas pa'i phur bu khrag byugs pa re re dag las thog ser 'beb pa/ dar nag gi stod g.yogs/ re bas smad g.yogs shing*/ sked la dug sbrul bcings pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags las grub pa'i gri gug me 'bar bas sdigs shing*/ g.yon pa na bdud kyi khram shing khra bo bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba dmar nag gtsigs pa zhal nas khrag dang dug nad skyugs pa/ spyan gsum me ltar 'bar ba la/ khrag gi mchil ma 'dzag cing*/ ljags glog gi 'od zer ltar 'phro ba/ zhabs 'chams stabs su byon par bsam/ skabs 'dir spyan 'dren bya/ mchod bstod/ dgug gzhug byed/ de nas gos lh+wam zhwa gsum po phyi nang mgo mjug bsgyur ba dang*/ phreng ba phyir phul/ sngags 'di bgrang*/ phaṭa ya ra mā sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka a/ pra tyaṃ gi ra trig yakṣa khren zlog zlog ma ma khren zlog ḍā ki ma pra tyaṃ gi ra trig khren zlog de yang mchod rten la sogs bon skor la/ gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs phyi log tu bskor ba bya/ dus der lan gsum thal mo brdab/ rtags ma byung na lan gsum sbrel/ rtags ni bud med dgra phyogs su kha blta/ ngu 'bod/ rgod/ brang brdung*/ thal ba gtor/ chu gsho/ zor 'phen no// de byung nas sngags 'gor oṃ sbyar la yakṣa khren zlog la sogs pa'i 'og ma'i sngags gsum kho na bgrang*/ des ltas ngan kun bzlog go /drag mo'i zlog sngags so// rgyun tu mngon rtogs gang bsgom yang sngags 'di bzla'o// a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces so// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma sha chang gis brgyan pa la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sdes bskor ba spyan drang*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam/ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ pa liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod kyis mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung byed/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes brjod do// dgra bgegs zlog pa ni/ rang gi mdun du mkha' 'gro ma rang dang 'dra ba gcig bsgom/ rang gi mthe bong gser gyi st+wa gri/ mdzub mo dngul gyi gtan pa/ de'i bar du dgra bgegs kyi lus rid cing skra 'dzings pa'i mgo bo bcad/ mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du gsol bar bsam zhing*/ phreng ba phyir bsgyur/ sngags nyi ma nub pa'i grib so la kha bltas thal mo brdab bo// gtad dang rdzu 'phrul mchog gis kyang mi tshugs so// kho rang la zlog go /sngags bgrang zhing dgra yid la byas nas thal mo brdabs pas dgra 'chi/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po las 'od me stag tu 'phro ba/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pa dang*/ zhal nas me 'bar gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar du bsam zhing*/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong lcags kyi gtun bur bsam/ yig 'bru mdzub mo lcags kyi gtan par bsam/ phreng rdog rnams dgra bgegs kyi mgo bo khrag 'dzag par bsam/ phreng ba lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis phyir bsgyur/ nyi zer yod na rgyab nyi ma la gtad/ sngags bzlas zin pa dang*/ rang la mchod pa lngas mchod/ gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrungs nas gnas par bya'o// lam gyi jag pa chom rkun srung ba'i thabs la/ zan gtsang ma zhig la theb kyu gcig byas la bden pa brdar/ lam 'di na gnas pa'i jag pa chom rkun thams cad khug cig

ces theb kyu la bstim/ sngags ci mang 'debs/ sngags ni/ oṃ oṃ thum thum ril ril shaka shaka smug smug du ma'i mgo la thum/ ces so// 'di'i rjes la theb kyu gri lcags kyi khang pa sgo med pa de'i nang du jag pa chom rkun thams cad tshud pa'i dmigs pa bya'o// nyen las grol ba dang zan de ya so can la ster ro// bla ma sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag*// ༈ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ma'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ yig 'bru bcu bzhi po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ sku mdog mun pa ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ lcags kyi ral pa rting par slebs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces ci mang bzla/ bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi=

dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nad gdon bar chad/ chag chen nyam nga byad kha rbod gtong la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad da lta nyid du phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig stong par gyur cig ces brjod/ thal mo lan gsum brdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis la sogs pa brjod do// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /seng gdong ma'i spyan 'dren mchod bstod bzhugs/ au ḍī yan gyi gnas mchog tu// so sa gling gi dur khrod nas// rgyal ba bskyed dang rol pa'i yum// ye shes ḍā ki seng gdong ma// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs bcas// brtse chen thugs rjes skur bzhengs la// thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir byon// rnal 'byor 'dod pa 'grub par mdzod// dzñā na ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ stong nyid dag pa'i chos 'byung dbus// bde chen khrag zhags rgya mtsho'i klong*// zung 'jug ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// snang stong rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// snang srid dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// phyi nang gsang ba mchod pa'i sprin// dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// ba liṃ gtor ma'i snang brnyan du// shar ba'i 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho che// 'bul lo chos nyid ngang du rol// dmigs med thugs rjes bdag skyongs shig /hūm̐ bhyo/ rgyal ba'i yum chen shes phyin ma// rdo rje lus kyi tsaṇḍa lī// dharma gañdzi chos bdag ma// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso la bstod// khyod sku mig sman lhun po'i spor// seng zhal zla shel gsar pa ni// ljags dmar mtshams sprin drwa ba'i gseb// rab 'jigs mche ba'i 'od phreng can// hūm̐ phaṭa phaiṃ sgra'i gad rgyang dgod// lcags ral nag po 'thur du 'phyangs// dur khrod rgyan cha'i sil khrol can// sgeg pa'i gar mdzad dpa' ba'i nyams// 'jigs shing gtum pa'i khro chen ma// phyag g.yas zangs gri rnon po yis// sdig can mgo snying tshal par 'gems// g.yon pa dud chen pad snod du// dam nyams yongs kyi snying khrag 'thung*// shes rab dga' ma khyod nyid la// yab mchog bde chen he ru ka

/kha ṭwāṃ dbyug pa'i gzugs kyis 'khyud// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i dngos// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i ded dpon du// shar ba'i ngo mtshar rol rtsed mkhan// rang sems spros bral sprin lam du// med bzhin snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul la// skye med brag gi rnga sgra ltar// 'dzin med blo 'das ngang nas bstod// khyod thugs bde chen dpag bsam shing*// mtshan rtog spros pa'i dri bral yang*// smon lam dag pa'i 'dod dgu'i tshogs// rnal 'byor dbang por myur du stsol// zhes pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa char pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyi sgrub thabs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru siṃ ha mu khi' yai/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i rjes su/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing seng zhal rab tu 'bar ba gdangs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas pad nyi dang ro mnan pa/ chos 'byung gi nang du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de lta bu'i ba spu'i bu ga nas spros pa'i me 'od dang pho nyas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par bsam zhing*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces drag tu bzla zhing*/ mthar lag pa nyi zla brdab pa'i bar du gnod byed thal bar brlag par bsam zhing thal mo lan gsum brdab bo// bgegs dang log par 'dren pa dang*// zhes sogs smon lam dang lta ba bdag med pas rgyas gdab bo// zhes pa 'di yang nyung ngu la mos pa rnams kyi ngor mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bris pa'o//

༈ /zhe sdang rnam dag rnam shes gnas gyur pa// chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das// gdul bya'i dbang gis rab 'jigs khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// char sprin ltar gnag mi sdug seng ge'i zhal// rab gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril sdang mig gzigs// gri gug thod 'chang brkyangs skum gar stabs can// ye shes me phung 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// thod skam sbrul dang stag gi sham thabs sogs// dur khrod chas ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun// spro zhing sdud mdzad dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// skal ldan rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod sku rab khros bdud dpung skrag mdzad cing*// hūm̐ phaṭa gsod chems 'jigs rung gad rgyangs sgrogs// dmigs med khyab bdal chos dbyings rdo rje'i thugs// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad stems dang*// rig sngags rbod gtong 'khrul 'khor gtad khram dang*// dmag dang 'khrugs pa la sogs phyi nang gi /mi mthun bar chad thams cad zlog par mdzod// ces kyang smras so// sarba maṅga laṃ ku ru// ༈ /seng gdong sngon mo'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// swa sti/ seng ge'i gdong can bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'dra/ rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su pad nyi la dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ro'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan/

snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong dang gnod byed thams cad bsregs shing tshar bcad par bsams nas/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzla/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang la sbyor ba maṇḍal chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su tshon phung nag po bkod/ gtor ma gru gsum dmar po gtor rgyan dang bcas pa/ de'i mthar phyogs mtshams su mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ rdor dril me tog maṇḍal/ gu gul la sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo// dngos gzhi/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin brlab/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs shlo ka gsum gyis spyan drang*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī sogs nas dbur brgyan/ zhes dang*/ mchod pa oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas/

shabda āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlab/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ sogs nas shabda'i bar dang*/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi ta brjod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtong ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags sam sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar ro// mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa grub 'phral/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu tshar nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab ste/ 'dir zhi rgyas dbang drag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha du ma zhig yod pa las 'dir drag po mngon spyod kyi rigs su gtogs pa mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sngon mo'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun pa bya ba'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba dang mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po gnyis bgro gleng byas pas lo tsā ba rgyal bas/ der kho zhe sdang skyes te khyod ngan sngags kyis zhag bdun nas 'chi bar byed zer nas song bas lo tsā ba zhed pas/ mu stegs kyis khyod lha dkon mchog gsum spongs la nga'i bstan pa la zhugs/ gser gyi sdud pas sna drangs pa'i dpe cha rnams me la sregs zer ro// tshe 'di mi rtag yud tsam yin/ khyod kyi bstan pa la nga mi 'jug lha dkon mchog gsum mi spong*/ de bas 'chi ba drag byas pas/ mu stegs na re/ khyod zhag bdun nas 'chi ba'i dus ston zer/ lo tsā ba zhed nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/

rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal nas/ nga la thabs yod kyi/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la tshogs 'khor shoms la gsol ba thob cig ḍā ki mas lung bstan 'ong gi gsung nas/ lo tsā bas de bzhin byas pas/ nam phyed tsam na mdun gyi nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can me dkyil na ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa zhig byon nas/ zhed mi dgos/ rdo rje gdan na pha wang g.yag 'dra ba zhig gi 'og na/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi nor sgrub ces kyang bya ba/ tshe sgrub ces kyang bya ba/ btsan mthu zlog pa'i zlog pa yod chog ces kyang bya/ mtshon srung pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// dgra bo brlag par 'gyur ro// 'khor lo yod na phyogs ngan bdud gcod las thar/ lha 'dre kun gyi srung zhing grogs byed do// mthu dang ngan sngags mkhan kha nas khrag skyugs nas 'chi'o// dug dang mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ sngags pa stong gis brubs kyang mi tshugs/ bde mor nyal bas chog bkra shis pa dang*/ don 'grub pa'i gdams pa yod pas de thon la chig brgyud du spel/ sgom bzlas nyin zhag phrug gcig la bdun las mang ba ma bgrang*/ mtshams dang smra bcad ma byed/ byas na rtags yong gsungs nas yal song*/ lo tsā bas der phyin nas pha wang dras te 'og brus pas gser gyi sgrom bu gcig gi nang nas/ ḍā ki ma bye ba 'bum gyi yang snying chu dar dmar po la bris pa zhig byung*/ de bton pa'i tshe cho 'phrul chen po byung ngo*// de gser gyis dbu can du bris te lus g.yon pa la btags/ zhag gsum sngags bgrangs pas der mu stegs pa kho khrag skyugs nas shi'o// shi ba thos nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyang ma shi ba/ kho yang ma shi ba zhig byung na legs te/ mu stegs pa yang lam tshol ba la zhugs pa yin pas bsad du mi rung ba yin/ mtshams ma bcad par lus la btags pas chog pa yin te/ bla ma la nyan pa'i slob ma nyung*/

khyod kyis sngags bgrangs pas kho shi bas/ da de'i sdig sbyong la gsung rab 'ga' zhig bzhengs gsungs so// de lta bu'i gdams pa khyad par can 'di la du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rang gi bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro slob dpon la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dngos yin snyam pas maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas rgyun bshags bya ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos te/ de'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas hūm̐ yig rnams gsal btab ste/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/

thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rol mo dang gu gul gyi bdugs/ sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ des mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas te/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ aḥkaḥsogs lan gsum/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te slob dpon la me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ de ltar byas pas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gsung gi sogs rigs 'gre'o// byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyang gis bye ste byon pa khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim ste/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dang dbyer med du gyur pa mos par byas te/ de'i ngang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi thugs kyis sogs rigs 'gre'o// gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du gtor ma mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can du mos pa byas te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ aḥkaḥsogs kyi mthar/

mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la dus rtag tu 'bral ba med par bzhugs nas byang chub ma thob bar gyi steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa dang*/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa dang*/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po the'u rang gi gnod pa la sogs pa zhi ba dang*/ gzhan yang gzugs can dgra'i gnod pa/ gzugs med bgegs kyi gnod pa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong mnan gtad zor gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bsam don chos bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthar thug mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi go 'phang bde blug tu thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can du gsal ba de las mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa zhig chad de khyed rang gi spyi bor thim par mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub rjes gtso bos sogs/ maṇḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ tshom bu'i lha la mchod pa byin brlab/ mchod bstod bzod gsol byas la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te/ bkra shis dang dga' ston bya'o// 'di yang rong po dbon po chos dbang gis rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor rdo rje 'chang buddha'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i btsun pa ga ga na shrī bha dras sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgrub rdzong la gzhi byas/ gsung sgros cung zad kyis brgyan te/ shin tu dag par yos lo khrum gyi zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi nyin dpal e waṃ chos ldan yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /gser chos kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

dpal gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro dbyer med la// gus pas btud de dpal mo yi// bsnyen pa bya tshul cung zad bri// de la 'di'i rjes su gnang ba dang man ngag legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ma'i bsnyen pa bya ba la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes phan yon bstan pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis sam/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes gang yang rung bar gnas dben par sgrub pa po kha shar ram lhor phyogs pa dang bstun par 'byor na 'di nyid kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ gtor ma gru gsum rtse mo ha cang rno ba ma yin pa smug rtsis byugs pa rgyan ldan dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi la zlum gtor gcig dang bcas pa bsham/ de'i mdun du nye bar spyod pa dang*/ nub dang po la dgos pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa po stan la 'dug ste/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa ltar dpang por bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar gnas pa'i 'dun pa dang ma bral bas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chab kyis bran pa la bsang sbyang bya ba nas brtsams te/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor ba'i bar la phal cher bde mchog gam mkha' spyod kyi cho ga las 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin du bya zhing*/ khyad par ni phrin las bcol ba'i skabs su/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i ched du bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin du bgyid par 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyis bar gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba dang*/

drag sngags zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyi rjes su 'di'i gsang sngags a ka sa ma sogs kyang rjod cing gu gul gyis bdug go /de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ nub dang por nang mchod la dmigs te/ suṃmbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me sogs nas/ ha ho hrīḥ'i bar kho bos byas pa'i seng gdong ma mchod pa'i cho ga las 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs te bzhag go /de nas gnas dang yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la/ oṃ sumbha ni zhes sogs nas/ dharmā ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab pa'i bar yang sngar smos ma thag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga ltar bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la sogs pas mdzad pa gang mos kyi steng nas nyams su blang ste/ de'ang bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi 'gro tsam byed na sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ srung ba dang zlog pa'i dmigs pa khyad par ba ni yi ge rnying pa rnams nas 'byung ba'am/ mchod pa'i cho ga nyid du bkod pa ltar bya'o// de'ang snga dro la sogs pa bsnyen pa'i skabs su srung ba'i dmigs pa gtso bor bton nas/ thun gyi mthar zlog pa'i dmigs bzlas cung zad re byas la dmod pa dor ba dang bstun la thal mo lan gsum brdab pa dang*/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings su sgrol zhes pa'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// gzhan du na zlog pa dngos kyi dus na dgong mo nyi ma thal kar gtso che bar bshad do// thun bsdu ba na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam zhing brjod do// dgong thun la skabs 'dir gtor ma phul te/ de'ang gtor ma nang mchod dang chus sbyangs nas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thog mar kye rdo rje la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na sngon du de dag la phul/

de nas 'di nyid kyi gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pam̐ las padma zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar rang nyid kyi khyad par dor ba ma gtogs sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drang ngo*// gang ltar yang thod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul lo// de nas chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma dang 'brel na 'dir 'bul lo// gang ltar yang mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phul ba'i mthar/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ rten la brtan bzhugs bya ba dang*/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi ltar bya'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs pa'i nang du rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rnams bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas thun gsum mam bzhi gang mos byas te/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni khri phrag drug la sogs pa gsungs kyang*/ thog ma'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bcu bzhi nges par mdzad pa phyag len no// de lta bu'i rim pas sngags kyi grangs song ba dang*/

gsang sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ kha skong ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na logs su gsal ba ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i las tshogs mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ bye brag tu gzhan gyi byad kha la sogs pa'i gnod pa phyir zlog pa'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// de ltar grangs med mkha' 'gro yi// gtso mo seng ge'i gdong pa can// ba ri lo tsā'i gser chos kyi// bsnyen pa bya tshul nyung gsal 'di// bris pa'i dge ba'i 'gro ba rnams// mi dang mi min nyer 'tshe las// rnam par rgyal nas mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston par shog /ces pa gser chos lugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ma'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ don du gnyer ba'i dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i ched du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ bha wa tu// ༈ /gong gi bsnyen yig gi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i nang mchod dang gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ thog mar mdun gyi nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces zhal bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams bskol bas 'od du zhu nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/

rdo rje'i rtses gnas dang yo byad rnams la 'thor zhing*/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i mthar rol mo sna tshogs byas te/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni srung zlog la sogs pa so sor mi bya bar spyi 'gro ltar byed na sgrub thabs kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas sngags bzla/ so sor phye ba'i dmigs pa nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ yig rnying rnams nas rgyas par 'byung ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir dmigs bsal cung zad brjod na srung ba la/ rang mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa langs thabs su yod pa'i lte bar/ nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi gur khang gi dbus su hūm̐ yig sngon po gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ de'i steng la sogs par bsrung bya rnams yod par bsams te/ de yang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na klad kor gyi nang du bsgom/ khog pa'i nang du rang gi ming yig dang po thig les mtshan pa dang*/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bsrung bya pho/

g.yon du mo/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi rnam pa can du bsams pa'i snying gar so so'i ming yig dang po thig les mtshan pa dang bcas pa gsal btab/ de'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yon skor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong dang gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas bdag dang bsrung bya'i yul gyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ lus ngag yid gsum nus mthu dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa ci nus bzla/ mthar mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis sogs gsol gdab dkyus ltar dang*/ khyad par bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ gdon thams cad dang*/ dug dang rims nad thams cad las bsrung du gsol zhes brjod/ de bzhin du zlog pa'i dmigs pa ni gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma sku tshad shin tu che zhing gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang 'dra bar bsams pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer me'i phreng ba lta bu dpag tu med pa spros pa dang*/ rang gi ral pa'i gseb dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ de rnams kyis pha rol kyi byad kha rbod gtong mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing tshar bcad par bsams la sngags ci nus bzla'o// de nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa nyi ma dang*/ g.yas pa zla bar bsams pa'i bar du gnod byed dgra bgegs yod par dmigs la/ ngag tu rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi=

gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba ngan pa rtsom pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces dang*/ thal mo lan gsum brdabs pa'i bar du gnod byed thams cad btsir bas thal bar brlag rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa rnams kyis byad ma gnod byed rnams kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsams la/ ngag tu/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// zhes brjod/ slar yang sprul pa'i tshogs rnams tshur 'dus te phyi rol tu srung ba'i gur gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// de nas gdan bsdu ba sogs dkyus bzhin no// zhes pa'ang zhu chen rin po che rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mchod chog phrin las zla 'od gsar pa'i pho nya las nyer mkho'i ched zur du phyung ba'o//

༈ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyi sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ ye shes me 'od dkar gsal 'khyil pa'i klong*// 'dzum dkar nyams kyi rol pas sdig sgrib dang*// bar du gcod pa zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo la btud nas// gsang sngags nus pa'i tsha gdung 'bar ba'i kha// mi mthun mun pa za phyir ches glal ba'i// sreg blugs cho ga ye shes me yi lce// bskyod 'dir bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol// de la 'dir mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba la sogs pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga brtsam pa la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ yongs su sbyangs pa'i sa gzhi la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i dbus nas khru phyed pa'i tshad kyis zlum por bskor/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis su bskor ba ni thab dang kha khyer dang mu ran no// de'i phyi rol tu thab stegs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ dbus su zlum skor nang ma dang nub kyi tshangs thig 'dzoms nas lte ba'i bar sleb pa'i srad bu'i tshad kyis zlum skor de nyid kyi g.yas dang g.yon du ji tsam sleb pa'i mtshan ma gnyis byas te/ de gnyis dang shar gyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor nang ma 'dzom sa gsum po thig gis gru gsum gyi dbyibs su sbrel lo// de'i nang du'ang ji tsam rigs pa'i tshad kyis me ris kyi thig kyang btab ste chos 'byung me ri dang bcas pa'o// thab kyi gzhi tshon thams cad ni dkar po dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba 'bri ba dang*/ bcad tshon rnams dmar skya bya ba sogs spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ me ri'i kha dog rang mdangs dang*/ chos 'byung sngon po byas pa'i dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshon spungs sngon po dgod do// kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing skam por brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor ting lo rtswa skam po dang bcas pa bsham mo// thab mdun tu sgrub pa po 'dug pa'i mdun du bsang chu/

'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ dgang gzar blugs gzar ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams sta gon bya/ rang gi g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gnyis bsham/ rang gi g.yas su yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ til dang*/ zho mar phye/ gzhan yang 'bras/ sur dkar gyi me tog smug rtsi dngul chu rin po che sna tshogs brdar ba'i phye ma rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog dang*/ ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi rnams bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i ril bu dang*/ dūrba dang ku sha rnams 'og tu dgos pa'i grangs dang mthun par bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus su 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas/ gdan rang la thim pa'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas bsang chu hūm̐ ring po bdun nam nyer gcig tsam gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ sngags de nyid kyis thab dang rdzas rnams la gtor te bgegs bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsreg rdzas dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thab la dmigs te/ oṃ sumbha sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ ring po yang yang brjod de byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pa'i yam shing gi rtse la me sbar te/

oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod cing*/ thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor te me tshang du gzhug pas me sbar ro// de nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang gzar dang blugs gzar bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg pas bud shing la khyab pa'i mar gyi rgyun blugs te/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod pa lan gsum gyis me gso'o// der 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su padma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la bcibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gundhe 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yob cing*/ ngag tu/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ agni ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha kaḥ kā ru ṇya kṛtwā satwa artha asminsanni hi to bhā wa/ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs te dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas ku sha'i chun po rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa ā/ zhes pas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas me lha'i ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ agna ye ā dī bya ā dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bahna ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ oṃ agna ye re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ agna ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas yam shing la/ agna ye swā hā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gi mthar/ oṃ agna ye bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

gnas skabs gzhan du bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ gdon thams cad dang*/ dug dang*/ rims nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab brjod do// de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis mar dang*/ til dang*/ zas mchog dang*/ mngar gsum gyi ril bu dang*/ dūrba dang*/ ku sha rnams kyang yam shing gi grangs dang mnyam par phul ba'i mthar/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa snga ma ltar byas nas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes dang*/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsam mo// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed pa dang*/ de'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ a ka sa ma ra tsa sogs 'ga' zhig mar la sngags te/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī ā dī bya ā dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bahnā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i mthar bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog pa med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs spel tshig sbyar ba dang bcas pa bdun tshan gsum gyis byon zan dbul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi dang bcas pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs kyis bstod do// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa brgyad phul ba'i mthar/

sdig pa sbyong ba dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i don du til mdun du bzhag la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las sdig sgrib thams cad yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas brgyud mar byung*/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su byung ste mdun gyi til la thim pas/ til zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur pa lha'i zhal du phul bas bdag rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag snyam du bsam zhing*/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa brgya stong la sogs pa spel tshig dang bcas pa brjod cing phul bas grangs bzung ngo*/ slar yang gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ba dang*/ oṃ sumbha sogs kyis bsang sbyang nas brtsams te/ 'di nyid kyi mchod pa'i cho ga kho bos byas pa las 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ spro na/ yid 'ong lhung lhung snyan pa'i chab sgra can// zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang bcas pas gaṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo'i bar dang*/ gos zung 'bul ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum la sogs pa nas/ ba len tsa ye swā hā'i bar gyis nang mchod dang*/ yid byung gi mchod pa rnams 'bul la/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa'ang bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes pas bstod/ rgyas pa la spro na chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa dang*/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa la sogs pa gang rigs kyis bstod do// gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me sogs kyang mchod pa'i cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pas 'bul ba nas/ 'dod don zhu ba'i bar gyis phul la/

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs te rang gi dpral bar thig le bya'o// gsum pa ni/ thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs te/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams te/ de la yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi lhag ma ji ltar rigs pa phul ba'i mthar/ gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar gdang blugs gsum 'bul ba dang mchod bstod bya'o// gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ agna ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo sogs lan gsum gyis phul la/ me lha'i rgyal po khyod kyis ni// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs// oṃ agna ye badzra muḥzhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// de nas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /seng ge'i gdong can zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gang shes dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis brjod cing*/ me tog gi char dbab pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la sogs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// me mnal ba dang thal ba mis mi 'gom sar dor ba gal che'o// smras pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs dang ḍā ki nī// rab dgyes zhal gyi ma dros las 'ongs pa'i// gdams pa ches zab sindhu'i chab kyi rgyun// brgyud 'dzin mkhyen pa'i sa la ci yang 'khyil// gzhan yang bka' dang zab gter gzhung mang las// sna tshogs las kyi 'dod pa rtag 'jo yang*// bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas rnams kyi las// stong pa'i mkha' la bos ltar lad mo med// de bsam don du gnyer 'gar phan bya'i phyir// zhi ba'i sreg blugs bris pa'i dge ba yis// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub kyi// 'byung gnas yon tan rgya mtsho mngon gyur cig

/ces pa gser chos kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce zhes bya ba 'di yang dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i ched du btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gser chos lugs kyi seng gdong ma'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang chen dpa' mo seng ge'i gdong*// dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje gdan pa che// don yod rdo rje ba ri lo tsā ba// brtse chen snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun grags rgyal mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang brag phug bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams la= /kun dga' bkra shis ngang tshul bzang po can// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan blo gros bzang po dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje lo chen chos skyong bzang*// sa skya lo tsā rnams la= /dkon mchog lhun grub dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*// shar chen kun bkras sher 'byung kun dga' legs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// bkra shis lhun grub rnams la= /shī la ratna la sogs byin rlabs dang*// las tshogs legs 'doms bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon// yi dam zhi khro seng gdong rigs lnga dang*// bstan srung nor lhar bcas la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma skyabs gsum nor bu gtsug 'chang ba'i// byang chub sems rtsal rdzogs pa'i skyes bu des// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug lam du gom bkod cing*// sku gnyis 'thob bya'i grong khyer phyin par shog /stong nyid rdo rje'i gur khyab 'bar ba'i nang*// dur khrod chos 'byung pad nyi bam chen steng*// seng zhal 'jigs ma'i gzugs sku bsgoms pa'i mthus// snod bcud tha mal snang zhen bzlog tu gsol// dpa' mo gang gi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// sgom bzlas brtson pa'i nus pas rang gzhan gyi// sgo gsum gzhom bral rdo rje'i srung ba la// bdud dgra bye ba'i co 'dris mi tshugs mdzod// phrag dog dug myos mi bsrun dgra bgegs dang*// byad mkhan sbrul gdug khros pa'i kha rlangs dug

/phyir zlog sngags kyi 'thor rlung drag po yis// gnod byed gang yin rlag cing gtor du gsol// kun rtog 'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs snang ba rnams// rnam par dpyad ngor skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi// blo 'das dbyings su sbyor sgrol mkhas 'gyur ba'i// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces gser chos lugs kyi seng gdong ma'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di'ang dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// zhes pa'i mtshams/ dpal ldan chos skyong rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rin chen mchog grub nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag 'jam dpal bzang po sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// bstan srung nor lhar bcas la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma skyabs gsum sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang pa'i tshul la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bdag sogs gtan gyi skyabs su bzung*// gzhan don bdud las rgyal bya'i phyir// ye shes khro mo bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ oṃ| chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// hūm̐ las rdo rje'i srung 'khor che// pad nyi mi ro'i steng du bdag /ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar// g.yon na thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ 'khyud// mgo phreng rus rgyan stag sham bklubs// me phung klong na brkyang bskum gar// dbang rtags rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// sprul pa'i khro mo'i 'phro 'du yis// gnod byed zlog cing tshar gcod mdzad// bzlas pa bya ba ni/

thugs kar nyi mar hūm̐ sngags phreng*// 'od kyi me 'bar gnod byed dang*// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i nus mthu bsregs// rgyal kun mthu stobs bdag la bsdus// zhes bsam zhing*/ a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa mā ra ya phaṭa/ ci nus bzla/ zlog pa byed na/ sngags de'i mthar/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad kha phur kha rbod gtong thams cad e sa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog ces btags pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ phyag gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du bsams pa'i bar du gnod byed dgra bgegs dmigs la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub mor rtsom pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir zlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe/ gnod byed de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod cing*/ thal mo lan gsum brdabs pas gnod byed kyi lus ngag nus mthu dang bcas rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsams la/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog

/rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// zhes brjod cing bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol ba po thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpyad na gshis lugs yod pa cir yang ma grub par shes pa de'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de las ldangs pa na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /seng ge'i gdong can 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes brjod do// zhes gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal mo rong pa'i dge slong bsod nams dpal ldan la sogs pa don gnyer 'gas rgyun du khyer bde zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar sug bris su bgyis par rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
